morphology.pattern_note: 外语专名，按整词记忆；历史姓名成分不是马来语词缀。音标为常见英式英语读法示例，具体读法以姓名持有者或当地惯例为准。

senses.zh_definition: 莫顿：外语姓氏，也可用作人名、地名或其他专名；具体所指依上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A surname also used as a personal name, place name or other proper name; its referent depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga asing yang juga boleh digunakan sebagai nama orang, tempat atau entiti lain; rujukannya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正文写作 Morton，不能据词频排名认定为标准马来语普通词。未提供上下文，不能指定某个人、地点或品牌。以下搭配为姓名使用示例，未声称具有已验证的高频性。姓氏依据：[Dictionary of American Family Names，经 Ancestry 提供](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/morton)。

etymology.historical_story: One established English and Scottish origin of Morton is a place name combining Old English mōr, meaning moor, with tūn, meaning farmstead or estate. A surname could thus preserve a family's association with a landscape. The surname dictionary also records other origins, so this explanation should not be assigned automatically to every bearer. [Source: Dictionary of American Family Names via Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/morton).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Morton 联想成荒原 moor 旁的一处聚落，帮助记住其一种历史来源；现代使用时仍按姓名“莫顿”整体识别。
